candidates.name: edgartools
candidates.what_it_holds: Python library turning SEC EDGAR filings into typed objects: 10-K/10-Q/8-K, 13F, Form 3/4/5, N-CSR/N-PORT, S-1, Schedule 13D/G; pulls standardized income statement/balance sheet/cash flow via XBRL and the Company Facts (frames-style) API; full-text search and HTML-to-markdown extraction; MIT license, 4,388+ commits, actively maintained.
candidates.why_useful: One-command point-in-time pull of ABNB/BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT XBRL financials and 8-K exhibits (KPI tables) straight from EDGAR, and could backfill the guidance ledger / peer-8-K-KPI table with an exact filing-date timestamp for gap 4 (point-in-time consensus/financials) and gap 15 (XBRL tooling).
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: we already hold 'all letters/transcripts/XBRL since IPO' pulled manually; this is a maintained tool to re-pull and to extend to BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT with point-in-time filing dates
candidates.time_coverage: EDGAR's full history (1993x2020s) via API, current as of filing
candidates.size_hint: n/a (API client, not a static dataset)

candidates.name: edgar-crawler
candidates.what_it_holds: Toolkit to download 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings and parse them into structured JSON by item section; companion released datasets EDGAR-CORPUS (huggingface.co/datasets/eloukas/edgar-corpus, 1993-2020, ~220k 10-K filings split train/val/test, 23 extracted item sections per filing, 40.7GB) and EDGAR-W2V (Word2Vec embeddings on Zenodo). GPLv3, presented at WWW 2025, 95 commits, active.
candidates.why_useful: Gives a ready parser for 8-K text (management commentary, KPI tables) across any peer (BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT) with section-level structure, useful for building a comparable-KPI extraction pipeline; EDGAR-CORPUS itself is a large pre-built text corpus for tone/NLP work spanning management-statement history well before our current IPO-forward pull.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: extends our letters/transcripts corpus (which starts at ABNB IPO) to a cross-company, pre-2020 text corpus
candidates.time_coverage: 1993-2020 (EDGAR-CORPUS); crawler itself pulls current filings too

candidates.name: EDGAR-CORPUS (companion dataset to edgar-crawler)
candidates.what_it_holds: https://huggingface.co/datasets/eloukas/edgar-corpus and Zenodo mirror: 1993-2020 annual-report (10-K) text, ~176,289 train + validation/test splits (~220k total filings), fields = filename/CIK/year plus 23 structured sections (Item 1 through 9B incl. 1A/1B/7A/9A/9B), 40.7GB total, per-year configs available (year_1993...year_2020).
candidates.why_useful: Large pre-extracted MD&A/risk-factor text corpus across all EDGAR filers (would include BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT annual reports pre-2021) for building a management-tone or peer-commentary time series without re-scraping EDGAR.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: none directly; complements EDGAR-CORPUS entry above
candidates.last_activity: dataset released alongside 2021 paper, cited through 2025

candidates.name: secfsdstools (SEC Financial Statement Data Set tools)
candidates.what_it_holds: Python tools that pull SEC's official quarterly 'Financial Statement Data Sets' (num/sub/tag/pre CSV zips from sec.gov, ~500,000+ filings since 2010, 120M+ data points, 2GB+ of zips by 2023) and convert to local parquet with standardization/filtering utilities for cross-company/cross-year comparison. Apache-2.0, 654 commits.
candidates.why_useful: Gives point-in-time, as-filed line-item financial statement data (not restated) for every SEC filer including BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT since 2010 in one pull, directly useful for a peer financial-statement panel and for point-in-time XBRL-tag-level figures (occupancy/RevPAR footnote tags where tagged).
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: extends our XBRL-since-IPO ABNB-only pull to full peer set and to standardized point-in-time quarterly vintages
candidates.size_hint: 120M+ data points, 2GB+ raw zips (source), local parquet output
candidates.last_activity: 654 commits, described as maintained through 2023+ features (daily-update support v2.4.0)

candidates.name: python-edgar
candidates.what_it_holds: Stitches EDGAR quarterly full-index files (company name, CIK, filing date, form type, URL) into one master index spanning 1993-present; zero dependencies, MIT, 48 commits (last visible activity ~2018, since forked/maintained by others).
candidates.why_useful: Lightweight way to build a master filing-date index for BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT/ABNB (all form types, all years) to drive point-in-time filing-date joins for the vintage register.

candidates.name: sec-edgar-downloader
candidates.what_it_holds: Python package to bulk-download any SEC filing type (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, 13F, DEF 14A, S-1, SC 13D/G, 300+ types) by ticker or CIK; no bundled data, pulls live from EDGAR. MIT, 212 commits.
candidates.why_useful: Straightforward bulk downloader to grab every 8-K/10-Q for BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT for a peer-print KPI extraction pipeline.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: overlaps edgartools/datamule/python-edgar functionally; include for completeness/reliability comparison

candidates.name: sec-api-python (sec-api.io SDK)
candidates.what_it_holds: Python SDK for the sec-api.io service: full-text search over filings from 2001+, XBRL-to-JSON converter for full US GAAP taxonomy (income statement/balance sheet/cash flow), covers 20M+ EDGAR filings/100M+ exhibits since 1993. MIT license for the client; underlying API requires a free API key (rate-limited free tier) or paid plan for volume.
candidates.why_useful: Full-text search across all peer 8-Ks/10-Qs (e.g. searching 'RevPAR' or 'nights booked' phrases in filings 2001+) would be a fast way to build a peer KPI-mention index; the free tier may be enough for spot pulls without becoming a paid dependency (CLAUDE.md forbids paid keys as data source, so flag as method-only, do not adopt for the harness).
candidates.license: MIT (client); underlying API has free-tier + paid

candidates.name: datamule-python
candidates.what_it_holds: Python package for bulk SEC filing retrieval (10-K, Form 4, etc.) by ticker; free tier rate-limited to ~5 req/s directly against EDGAR, optional paid 'datamule' hosted archive ($1/100k downloads) for higher throughput. MIT, 673 commits, 557 stars.
candidates.why_useful: Alternative bulk-download client for building the peer 8-K/10-Q corpus at scale without hitting SEC's own rate limits as hard; free-tier path stays within our paid-key-free rule.
candidates.license: MIT (client); paid tier optional, not required

candidates.name: secedgar (sec-edgar crawler package)
candidates.what_it_holds: Python package (module name `secedgar`) for downloading corporate filings from EDGAR by ticker(s), including daily filings by date range and 10-Q batch pulls; Apache-2.0, 1.4k stars, 332 forks, 766 commits, active CI.
candidates.why_useful: Well-adopted alternative EDGAR bulk-download client (higher star count than most alternatives here) for the peer-print pipeline; good fallback if edgartools/datamule hit issues.
candidates.last_activity: 766 commits, 1.4k stars, actively maintained with GH Actions CI

candidates.name: OpenEDGAR
candidates.what_it_holds: Django-based framework that builds a local relational database from EDGAR filings, automating retrieval and parsing of EDGAR forms at scale (used to power LexPredict's commercial legal-document database). MIT, 332 stars, 99 forks, 54 commits, first released 2018.
candidates.why_useful: Heavier-weight option if the team wants a queryable local database (rather than flat files) of all peer + ABNB filings with full parsing pipeline already built, e.g. for building a structured 8-K/10-Q archive with a real ORM/schema.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: overlaps other EDGAR clients; heavier infra than needed for our team's scope
candidates.size_hint: n/a, framework only, older/less active (54 commits, oldest activity 2018)

candidates.name: sec-cik-mapper
candidates.what_it_holds: Generates and hosts (via GitHub + jsDelivr CDN) daily-updated CSV/JSON mapping files linking SEC CIK <-> ticker <-> company name <-> exchange, plus mutual-fund series/class ID mappings. MIT, 351 commits. NOTE: archived/read-only as of 26 Apr 2025, so mapping files are frozen at that date, not live-updating.
candidates.why_useful: Ready-made CIK/ticker crosswalk (ABNB, BKNG, EXPE, MAR, HLT and any peer) to join against XBRL frames / full-text search / financial-statement-dataset pulls without re-deriving CIKs by hand.
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: small utility, not a primary dataset
